Comfort Meets Capability.

Powerful Performance in a Premium Cab Tractor.

The 2024 KIOTI NS4710MCB brings together high horsepower, rugged capability, and operator comfort with a climate-controlled cab and 4WD performance. Featuring a 47 HP diesel engine and 12×12 fully synchronized transmission, this tractor is ideal for loader work, rotary cutting, hay handling, and all-around property management. Whether you’re working year-round in tough weather or just want comfort with your power, the NS4710MCB delivers.

Features may include:

47 HP Diesel Strength
Powered by a reliable KIOTI 4-cylinder diesel engine designed for durability and fuel efficiency.

12×12 Manual Shuttle Transmission
Fully synchronized forward and reverse gears allow for smoother control during loader operation and field tasks.

Climate-Controlled Cab
Fully enclosed cab with heat, A/C, and suspension seat for all-day, all-season comfort.

Independent PTO
540 RPM PTO with electro-hydraulic engagement ensures dependable power for a range of implements.

Lift-Ready 3-Point Hitch
Category I & II with up to 3,177 lbs lift capacity at the ends—compatible with most heavy-duty attachments.

4WD & Power Steering
Tackle uneven terrain with confidence using standard 4WD and hydrostatic power steering.

Hydraulic Versatility
Dual rear remotes and 16.5 GPM total hydraulic flow offer excellent support for implements and loader work.
